license_review_note: 2026-10-25 maintainer decision: license review completed by the maintainer, deliberately without external counsel. Basis: the written analyses of the model terms (Open RAIL-M paragraphs 4(a), 5, 7; clickwrap acceptance; governing law; liability) and of the copyleft obligations (GPL-3.0 paragraph 6(d), LGPL-2.1 paragraph 4, LGPL-3.0 election, MPL-2.0 paragraph 3.2), and the changes they led to: explicit in-app acceptance of docs/licenses/SUPERTONIC-MODEL-TERMS.md (hash-bound), an equally binding German version with a translated Attachment A, German law with the consumer proviso, a liability clause within German law, the DMG Licenses README, LGPL-3.0 for libquadmath, and corresponding source served publicly next to every download and verified by the publish job (docs/decisions/0007-gcc-runtime-libraries.md and its amendments). The maintainer accepts these residual risks without legal advice: whether Supertone Inc. can enforce Attachment A directly against end users; whether model weights are protected by copyright; whether the maintainer acts as a business (Unternehmer) towards consumers; the quality of the Attachment A translation; whether the retroactive LGPL-3.0 election cures the 2026-10-15 betas under German law; the unrecorded Homebrew bottle revision behind SciPy's GNU runtime libraries; and Stephen L. Moshier's copyright in some libquadmath files. Publishing still stops if the public source copies are not reachable with the expected size and SHA-256. The 2026-10-24 status (interpreter provenance, rebuilt runtime notices, model terms in every DMG) is unchanged.
